Handoff · artboard 4, "Include gig reviews" checkbox

Default: unchecked (false).

The intro under "What's being read now, against all time" reads "Posts ranked by views, gig reviews excluded." while the checkbox is unchecked (false).

When it is ticked (true), the word "excluded" is replaced with "included": "Posts ranked by views, gig reviews included."

The slope chart switches to the ranking that includes gig reviews at the same time.
